description: This PHP source file defines the AM_ProjectTemplatesController class, which extends SugarController. It contains methods for managing project templates, creating projects from templates, generating Gantt charts, updating tasks, and related project management functionalities within the SuiteCRM module. The class interacts heavily with the SugarCRM BeanFactory for CRUD operations and handles various project and task-related actions.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesController
classes.description: Controller class for handling project templates, including creating projects from templates, generating Gantt charts, and task management in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_create_project
methods.description: Creates a new project based on a project template, clones resources, copies tasks, and calculates project timeline and business hours.

methods.name: action_generate_chart
methods.description: Generates a Gantt chart for a project template, including start/end dates and rendering JavaScript code.

methods.name: action_update_GanttChart
methods.description: Updates or creates a project task with parameters received via POST, recalculates task end date based on business hours.

methods.name: action_delete_task
methods.description: Marks a task as deleted in the database.

methods.name: action_get_end_date
methods.description: Returns the calculated end date for a task with optional lag, formatted for display.

methods.name: action_update_order
methods.description: Updates the order of tasks based on a JSON-encoded array received via POST.

methods.name: action_get_predecessors
methods.description: Provides a list of task predecessors for a project template for selection in the UI.

methods.name: create_task
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a project template, setting various task properties including start and end dates.

methods.name: update_task
methods.description: Updates an existing task with new details.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Validates if a string is null or empty after trimming.
